entries.basis: Four named container owners and allocation boundaries are implemented/documented. Actual independent card and toolbar cases prove allocation-driven adaptation; corrected toolbar normal/enlarged cases pass six executions, retaining sibling state, resizing, menus and keyboard focus.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-C-08 Reconcile original `C-08`: Use container size queries for reusable card, toolbar, navigation, and modal compositions; choose/document containment boundaries so consumers know what supplies the container. Historical status: open.

entries.basis: Owned beneficial fluid/min/max/rem sizing and viewport/reflow fallbacks are implemented with documented boundaries. Accepted actual browser zoom, cross-engine geometry, enlarged-control cases and rendered visual evidence establish primary mobile/reflow paths without claiming limited-support dependencies.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-C-12 Reconcile original `C-12`: Use fluid sizing such as `clamp` where beneficial without preventing text zoom; establish mobile/reflow fallbacks. Historical status: open.

entries.basis: Rem-based text roles have actual zoom/text-spacing/long-label/font-substitution evidence. The discovered false-positive toolbar enlargement fixture is fixed and now proves 24/28px computed control fonts with bounds and usability across three engines.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-D-09 Reconcile original `D-09`: Use rem-based text sizing and layouts that tolerate zoom, text spacing changes, long labels, and font substitution. Historical status: open.

limits: Exactly six fresh toolbar cases; other evidence retains original runtime/source scopes. Enlarged scoped font-token stress is distinct from real browser zoom. No new screenshot from passing toolbar run, physical dynamic-viewport, native-nesting support-floor, spoken AT or universal all-layout guarantee.
